ownership.sequenceCollections: sequence.actorActions/layers/effects/audio/events use offsets local to the sequence.
ownership.shotCollections: shot.cameraActions/layerActions/actorActions/dialogue/effects/audio/events use offsets local to the shot.
ownership.referenceRule: Actor references (actorId, targetActorId, camera targetEntityId/secondaryTargetEntityId, speakerActorId, listenerActorId and reaction.actorId) resolve to cast when non-empty. UI event targetEntityId is an explicit exception: ShowUi owns a generated presentation target keyed by its eventId, and HideUi targets that ShowUi eventId.

cameraActions.cameraPresetRule: cameraPresetId may be non-empty only when the owning sequence selects a usable Kit exposing that exact cameraId.
cameraActions.outputCameraInvariant: ChatGPT authors cameraActions and permitted target IDs only. The Unity tool creates exactly one active CUTSCENE_CAMERA on Display 1 for the selected generated layer, validates its world-visual culling mask, and owns camera/root activation. Do not invent a Camera asset, Display value or renderer setup.

actorActions.localSlowMotion: LocalSlowMotion requires finite speed greater than 0 and at most 1. Never change global Time.timeScale.
actorActions.anchorRule: anchorId may be non-empty only when the owning sequence selects a usable Kit exposing that exact anchorId.
actorActions.animationRule: animationAssetId must be an exact compatible Cutscene.Animation record when non-empty; author PlayAnimation only when the exact ID appears in the actor record's exported compatibleAnimationIds list. Never infer compatibility from filename, folder, naming, or visual similarity. When verified options are supplied, prefer the exact matching Run, Walk, Hit or Idle animation requested by the story. Move controls world movement and PlayAnimation controls visual animation; a running person normally uses both. Without verified animation proof, use Move, Turn, Hold or another non-animation action.

layerActions.backgroundSortingRule: FarBackground and Background require sortingOrder less than 0.
layerActions.kitBackgroundRule: Do not duplicate the visible background supplied by a selected Kit as a free layer.

dialogue.overlapRule: Spoken dialogue lines may touch but may not overlap in absolute time.
dialogue.speakerRule: Props and scenery should not receive spoken dialogue unless their authored identity is explicitly a speaking character.
dialogue.dialogueStageV1: Optional stage selects one fixed SPEAKER_FOCUS, TWO_SHOT or COMMAND_SCREEN layout, fixed character slots, optional speakerDistance/listenerDistance values from exactly NEAR/MID/FAR, system-owned position/scale/framing, UI form, pose, text mode and exact Catalog assets. Arbitrary screen coordinates, anchors, colors and scales are forbidden.
dialogue.dialogueExpressionRule: speakerExpression and listenerExpression are evaluated on every dialogue line; an unavailable expression uses the profile's safe visual/Neutral fallback with a warning.
dialogue.optionalVisualFallback: Optional presentation assets may fall back safely. Required participant visuals may use built-in identity fallback only when the selected preset exports allowsBuiltInParticipantFallback=true and the referenced cast identity exists; otherwise choose another exact compatible tuple/preset or return one blocker.

lockedDialogueActorActions.framingChanges: use an explicit HardCut between shots
lockedDialogueActorActions.shotActorActions: When stage.lockStaging=true, the owning shot.actorActions MUST be empty.
lockedDialogueActorActions.authoringRule: When any dialogue line in a shot has stage.lockStaging=true, the owning shot.actorActions MUST be empty. Do not use Hold, FreezePose, Enter, Exit, Move, PlayAnimation, or any other world-actor action to keep a dialogue actor static. Dialogue visuals are controlled by the dialogue presentation fields only; place world-actor activity in a separate action shot before or after the locked dialogue shot.

effects.assetRule: Only the listed built-in overlay effects may omit assetId. All other effect types require an exact suitable Catalog assetId.

events.pointAction: Events are point actions except that a ShowUi/HideUi pair defines one generated UI visibility interval.
events.handoffRule: Gameplay transfer belongs in the typed handoff object, not in cinematic events.
events.uiRule: ShowUi creates one generated CUTSCENE_UI presentation from an exact Ui-primary assetId. Unity deterministically binds ShowUi to its own eventId when targetEntityId is omitted. Put a later HideUi in the same owner and set HideUi.targetEntityId to the ShowUi eventId; Unity derives the visible duration from that pair when ShowUi.floatValue is not positive. HideUi normally omits assetId. Do not use ShowUi/HideUi as arbitrary fullscreen overlay shortcuts.
events.spatialRule: Do not fight source pixel dimensions with arbitrary transforms. Unity Cover-fits Background/FarBackground layers, applies bounded semantic base sizing to world actors, and places ordinary generated UI in screen space. Author only deliberate story-relative motion/placement.
events.emotionRule: stage.speakerEmotion, stage.listenerEmotion and delivery.emotion use only Serious, Shock, Anger, Perplexed, Sad or Happy. Use speakerExpression/listenerExpression/reaction.expression for Determined, Concerned, Shocked, Relieved and similar acting choices.

transitions.durationRule: transitionIn.duration and transitionOut.duration must each be non-negative and no longer than the owning shot.
